# Daily multi-year walk-forward on the Zenodo national daily energy (generated by `scripts/run_daily_multiyear.py`)

Git commit `5ab2b23e35`. All-India daily energy met (MU), test years 2017-2024 (expanding training window, trained on everything before 1 January of the test year); hyper-parameters chosen once on the validation years 2021-2022 and frozen. **Folds 2021 and 2022 are in the tuning period (marked *); 2020 is the COVID year (marked c).** 2024 covers 1 January to 28 April only. National weather = the daily-study aggregate (population-weighted state means inside each grid region, equal weight over the five regions). Exploratory; not part of the frozen hourly protocol.

## Horizon 1 day

Selected on validation (2021-2022): ridge alpha 0.1; XGBoost validation MAE 49.7 MU, trees [360, 305, 275]; LSTM validation MAE 46.1 MU (hidden 32, lr 0.009034, dropout 0.19), epochs [26, 14, 18].

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2017 | 1,026 | 232 | 98.5 | 40.9 | 41.5 | 52.5 | +0.6 | +11.0 |
| 2018 | 1,258 | 333 | 115.1 | 44.0 | 46.0 | 42.9 | +2.0 | -3.1 |
| 2019 | 1,591 | 338 | 128.2 | 48.5 | 51.1 | 50.7 | +2.7 | -0.4 |
| 2020c | 1,929 | 190 | 162.9 | 57.0 | 69.7 | 66.8 | +12.8 | -2.9 |
| 2021* | 2,119 | 271 | 152.9 | 53.5 | 52.5 | 47.7 | -1.0 | -4.9 |
| 2022* | 2,390 | 332 | 131.4 | 51.0 | 49.3 | 48.8 | -1.7 | -0.5 |
| 2023 | 2,722 | 356 | 204.1 | 59.6 | 59.9 | 53.9 | +0.3 | -6.0 |
| 2024 | 3,078 | 117 | 116.1 | 51.1 | 45.6 | 48.6 | -5.5 | +3.0 |
| mean of all folds | | | 138.7 | 50.7 | 52.0 | 51.5 | +1.3 | -0.5 |
| mean of folds not in the tuning period or the COVID year (2017, 2018, 2019, 2023, 2024) | | | 132.4 | 48.8 | 48.8 | 49.7 | +0.0 | +0.9 |

XGBoost better than ridge in 3 of 8 folds; the LSTM better than XGBoost in 6 of 8 folds; LSTM better than ridge in 5 of 8 folds.
